battleV2Prompt: Create an original 16:9 pixel-art turn-based monster RPG BATTLE BACKGROUND asset only, 1536x864 composition. Not a UI mockup. No creatures, people, text, logos, buttons or HUD. Designed specifically to support Nintendo DS-era back-sprite combat composition, with clean professional modern pixel art at consistent small pixel scale. Low camera looking across a quiet forest clearing in soft morning light, distant woodland and blue hazy hills occupy the upper third; the foreground and middle two-thirds are a muted grass/sandy clearing with two subtle elliptical battle grounding areas: a LARGE near ellipse centered x=23%, y=79%, and a SMALLER distant ellipse centered x=71%, y=53%. Keep both ellipse centers empty and visually quiet to place transparent character sprites on later. Clear depth and stable flat ground, no water, no huge rocks in the playable center, no giant tree trunks, no dramatic fantasy lighting. Foreground grass edge only at the very bottom. Restrained sage/olive green, warm cream sand, desaturated blue distance; soft daylight, game-ready pixel art with broad readable shapes and a calm center. Scene should be wide and uncluttered, not highly detailed concept painting, not photorealistic. It must look like a plausible polished Nintendo DS monster battle clearing, while being an original environment.
